_doc: ResearchKnowledgeBase seed source (§45.1). Documented inventory of the prior-evidence findings the KB is seeded from BEFORE any new autonomous strategy research begins (§45.1, Appendix AB). Each entry preserves the §45.1 provenance fields and an explicit evidence-status label. These are IMPORTED CLAIMS, not verified facts (§45.1): a finding becomes edge only once REPRODUCED through the frozen-evaluator pipeline (§44/§56). Seed findings enter UNREPRODUCED/UNKNOWN and carry BIAS_AUDIT_REQUIRED where they touch the graduation cohort until the §45.2 audit clears. Source paths are the constitution's exact named documents (§45.1); on a machine where those artifacts are not yet present, this file is the documented seed list and the importer records provenance, not fabricated results.
_status_enum_source: §45.1: status ∈ {REPRODUCED, PARTIALLY_REPRODUCED, UNREPRODUCED, BIASED_SAMPLE, SUPERSEDED, FALSIFIED, UNKNOWN}

findings.cost_assumptions: reconciled priority-fee + tip + gas; 26.8% reconciled failure-rate attempt multiplier

findings.conclusion: At 0.01-SOL sizing, size-invariant fixed costs consumed 6-11% of every round trip before protocol fees, against winners averaging 14.6% — flat position size converted a plausible signal into a structural loss.
